AVCustomDeviceRoute.doc: An object that represents a custom device route.

AVCustomRoutingActionItem.doc: An object that represents a custom action item to display in a device route picker.

AVCustomRoutingController.doc: An object that manages the connection from a device to a destination.

AVCustomRoutingEvent.doc: An object that represents an event that occurs on a route.

AVCustomRoutingPartialIP.doc: An object that represents a full or partial IP address.

AVRoutingPlaybackArbiter.doc: An object that manages playback routing preferences.

AVCustomRoutingControllerDelegate.doc: A protocol for delegates of a custom routing controller.

AVRoutingPlaybackParticipant.doc: A protocol for objects that participate in playback routing arbitration.

AVCustomRoutingEventReason.doc: Values that indicate the reason for a routing event.

AVCustomRoutingEventReasonActivate.doc: A value that indicates that a user selects a route in the picker.

AVCustomRoutingEventReasonDeactivate.doc: A value that indicates that a user deselects a route in the picker.

AVCustomRoutingEventReasonReactivate.doc: A value that indicates to reactivate a route a user authorized previously.

-invalidateAuthorizationForRoute:.doc: Revokes an app’s authorization to connect to a route.

-isRouteActive:.doc: Returns a Boolean value that indicates whether a route is active.

-setActive:forRoute:.doc: Sets the active state of a route.

+sharedRoutingPlaybackArbiter.doc: Returns the singleton playback arbiter instance.

bluetoothIdentifier.doc: An identifier to use to establish a connection to a Bluetooth device.

networkEndpoint.doc: A local or remote endpoint to connect to.

overrideTitle.doc: A string to use to override the title of the item’s type.

type.doc: A type with an identifier that matches a value in the app’s configuration.

AVCustomRoutingControllerAuthorizedRoute.doc: A notification the system posts when the list of authorized routes changes.

customActionItems.doc: An array of custom action items to add to a route picker.

delegate.doc: A delegate object for a routing controller.

knownRouteIPs.doc: An array of route addresses known to be on the local network.

reason.doc: A reason for an event, such as a user request to activate or deactivate a route.

address.doc: A full or partial IP address for a device known to be on the network.

mask.doc: A mask that represents how many octets of the IP address to respect.

preferredParticipantForExternalPlayback.doc: The participant that has priority to play on external playback interfaces.

preferredParticipantForNonMixableAudioRo.doc: The participant that has priority to play audio when it’s not possible to play multiple audio sources concurrently.
